gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-vai: Bold tube-like letters from Tilt Neon keep one width all the way round, joints included. Noto Sans Vai, in sans-serif, sets words as solid blocks, with generous gaps where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-wancho: A tube-like stroke of constant width, plus a splayed c terminal, defines Tilt Neon. But Noto Sans Wancho brings a hulking, chalk-pressed lowercase and an e with a wide gap.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-warang-cit: Noto Sans Warang Citi, a sans-serif, lays words down as solid blocks, with wide channels leading into each counter. Let it stay modest in size under Tilt Neon's tube-like, constant-width headings.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-yi: Bold, wire-bent rounds give Tilt Neon its muscle. Noto Sans Yi, with a deep midsection and unlatched rounds, takes the text while the heading earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-traditional-nus: Broad-nibbed pen strokes that never curl shut give this pairing's text a friendly, unhurried read. Noto Traditional Nushu fills the line with full bowls, so page after page stays easy going beside Tilt Neon's drafting-pen outlines.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-numans: Clean lines meet loose ones: Tilt Neon's spaghetti-like strokes keep one width, while Numans tracks wide with swollen lowercase. That wide tracking in the sans-serif is what sets this pair apart.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-onest: A splayed c terminal marks Tilt Neon out at once. Onest, with short ascenders over big bowls and a gentle monotone of line thickness, makes paragraphs run smoothly.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-open-sans: Flat fineliner lines: Tilt Neon draws bold, tube-like strokes of constant width. Open Sans reads smoothly, with bulky lowercase and no clogged curves, so paragraphs flow without snagging anywhere.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear opens its letters like a pried oyster shell, lofty in the x-height. Preahvihear keeps text easy to settle into, a sans that lets Tilt Neon's thick-curved headings dominate.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption has big-bodied lowercase and bowls that feel unclosed and inviting. And beside Tilt Neon's bold, pinch-free strokes, paragraphs set in it move along without any fatigue.
